# Parameters

dPSI convention throughout the analysis: **dPSI = second condition − first condition**
(CTR_vs_TIS = TIS − CTR; TIS_vs_REPOP = REPOP − TIS; CTR_vs_REPOP = REPOP − CTR).
A positive value means higher inclusion in the second condition.

```{r params}
SIG_THRESHOLD  <- 0.05
DPSI_THRESHOLD <- 0.1
MIN_READ_COUNT <- 30     # rMATS only

EVENT_TYPES <- c("SE", "RI", "MXE", "A5SS", "A3SS")
COMPARISONS <- c("CTR_vs_TIS", "TIS_vs_REPOP", "CTR_vs_REPOP")

RMATS_BASE_DIR <- "/home/akos/Desktop/lab/TDK/rmats"
LEAF_BASE_DIR  <- "/home/akos/Desktop/lab/TDK/leafcutter2"
```

# 1. Loading rMATS

`invert_dpsi = TRUE` assumes that `--b1` is the first named condition in every comparison
(rMATS: IncLevelDifference = sample1 − sample2, hence the inversion). This cannot be verified
from the output alone; confirm it from the run command / `b1.txt`.

```{r rmats_load}
calc_mean_counts <- function(count_str) {
  if (all(is.na(count_str))) return(NA_real_)
  sapply(strsplit(as.character(count_str), ","), function(x) {
    mean(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
}

load_rmats_master_table <- function(dir_path, invert_dpsi = TRUE) {

  load_one_event_type <- function(ev) {
    f <- file.path(dir_path, paste0(ev, ".MATS.JC.txt"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) {
      warning(sprintf("Missing file: %s - skipped.", f))
      return(NULL)
    }

    df <- read.delim(f, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
    names(df) <- make.unique(names(df))

    coord_cols <- grep("Start_0base$|End$|ES$|EE$", names(df), value = TRUE)
    pos_vec <- apply(df[, coord_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, paste, collapse = "-")

    dpsi_num <- as.numeric(df$IncLevelDifference)
    if (invert_dpsi) dpsi_num <- -dpsi_num

    m_ijc1 <- calc_mean_counts(df$IJC_SAMPLE_1)
    m_sjc1 <- calc_mean_counts(df$SJC_SAMPLE_1)
    m_ijc2 <- calc_mean_counts(df$IJC_SAMPLE_2)
    m_sjc2 <- calc_mean_counts(df$SJC_SAMPLE_2)

    res <- data.frame(
      Event_ID    = paste(ev, df$chr, df$strand, pos_vec, sep = "_"),
      EventType   = ev,
      Chr         = as.character(df$chr),
      Position    = pos_vec,
      Strand_Info = as.character(df$strand),
      Gene_ID     = as.character(df$GeneID),
      Gene_Name   = as.character(df$geneSymbol),
      p_val       = as.numeric(df$PValue),
      p_val_adj   = as.numeric(df$FDR),
      dPSI        = dpsi_num,
      mean_IJC_1  = m_ijc1,
      mean_SJC_1  = m_sjc1,
      mean_IJC_2  = m_ijc2,
      mean_SJC_2  = m_sjc2,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # Coverage filter (rMATS only)
    res[(res$mean_IJC_1 + res$mean_SJC_1 >= MIN_READ_COUNT) |
        (res$mean_IJC_2 + res$mean_SJC_2 >= MIN_READ_COUNT), ]
  }

  combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(EVENT_TYPES, load_one_event_type))

  if (nrow(combined) == 0 || !"p_val_adj" %in% names(combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("No readable rMATS data found in: %s", dir_path))
  }

  combined %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_val_adj)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj, dplyr::desc(abs(dPSI)))
}

load_all_comparisons <- function(cell_line) {
  setNames(
    lapply(COMPARISONS, function(cmp) {
      load_rmats_master_table(file.path(RMATS_BASE_DIR, cell_line, cmp, "output"))
    }),
    COMPARISONS
  )
}

rmats_mcf7 <- load_all_comparisons("mcf7")
rmats_t47d <- load_all_comparisons("t47d")

get_rmats_sig_genes <- function(master_data) {
  master_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Gene_Name) %>%
    unique() %>%
    stats::na.omit() %>%
    as.character()
}

sig_genes_mcf7_rmats <- lapply(rmats_mcf7, get_rmats_sig_genes)
sig_genes_t47d_rmats <- lapply(rmats_t47d, get_rmats_sig_genes)
```

# 2. Loading LeafCutter

The MCF7 annotated effect-size table is used. For T47D, gene annotation is transferred from
MCF7 by coordinate (`chr:start:end`, without the `clu_` tag).
The TIS_vs_REPOP contrast is built in a single place: `deltapsi_REPOP - deltapsi_TIS`.

```{r leaf_load}
add_leaf_contrasts <- function(df) {
  stopifnot(all(c("deltapsi_TIS", "deltapsi_REPOP") %in% names(df)))
  df %>% dplyr::mutate(deltapsi_TIS_vs_REPOP = deltapsi_REPOP - deltapsi_TIS)
}

cluster_id <- function(intron) {
  stringr::str_replace(intron, "^([^:]+):[0-9]+:[0-9]+:(clu_.+)$", "\\1:\\2")
}

coord_id <- function(intron) {
  stringr::str_extract(intron, "^chr[^:]+:[0-9]+:[0-9]+")
}

load_leafcutter_mcf7 <- function() {
  ann_eff <- read.delim(file.path(LEAF_BASE_DIR, "mcf7_annotated_effect_sizes.txt"),
                        header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  sig_df  <- read.delim(file.path(LEAF_BASE_DIR, "mcf7_ds_results_cluster_significance.txt"),
                        header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, quote = "", fill = TRUE)

  ann_eff %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = cluster_id(intron)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(sig_df, by = "cluster") %>%
    add_leaf_contrasts()
}

load_leafcutter_t47d <- function(mcf7_annotated_df) {
  t47d_eff <- read.table(file.path(LEAF_BASE_DIR, "t47d_ds_results_effect_sizes.txt"),
                         header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!"intron" %in% colnames(t47d_eff)) t47d_eff$intron <- rownames(t47d_eff)

  t47d_sig <- read.delim(file.path(LEAF_BASE_DIR, "t47d_ds_results_cluster_significance.txt"),
                         header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, quote = "", fill = TRUE)

  # coordinate -> gene dictionary (one row per coordinate, multiple genes comma-separated)
  coord_gene_map <- mcf7_annotated_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name), gene_name != "") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(coord_key = coord_id(intron)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(coord_key) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(gene_name = paste(unique(gene_name), collapse = ","), .groups = "drop")

  t47d_eff %>%
    dplyr::mutate(coord_key = coord_id(intron), cluster = cluster_id(intron)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(coord_gene_map, by = "coord_key") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(t47d_sig, by = "cluster") %>%
    add_leaf_contrasts()
}

leaf_mcf7 <- load_leafcutter_mcf7()
leaf_t47d <- load_leafcutter_t47d(leaf_mcf7)

cat("T47D introns with gene annotation:\n")
print(table(has_gene = !is.na(leaf_t47d$gene_name)))

get_leaf_sig_genes <- function(merged_data, dpsi_col) {
  raw_genes <- merged_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(p.adjust < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(.data[[dpsi_col]]) > DPSI_THRESHOLD) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene_name)

  all_genes <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(stats::na.omit(raw_genes)), ","))
  all_genes <- stringr::str_trim(all_genes)
  unique(all_genes[all_genes != "" & all_genes != "NA"])
}

leaf_sig_list <- function(df) list(
  CTR_vs_TIS   = get_leaf_sig_genes(df, "deltapsi_TIS"),
  CTR_vs_REPOP = get_leaf_sig_genes(df, "deltapsi_REPOP"),
  TIS_vs_REPOP = get_leaf_sig_genes(df, "deltapsi_TIS_vs_REPOP")
)

sig_genes_mcf7_leafcutter <- leaf_sig_list(leaf_mcf7)
sig_genes_t47d_leafcutter <- leaf_sig_list(leaf_t47d)
```

# 3. Sanity checks (dPSI sign convention) and helper objects

Defines `cells`, `read_raw_rmats` and `leaf_col`, which are needed for the concordance analysis below.

```{r sanity_checks}
cells <- list(mcf7 = list(rm = rmats_mcf7, lf = leaf_mcf7),
              t47d = list(rm = rmats_t47d, lf = leaf_t47d))

# 1. rMATS: is the loaded dPSI identical to the one recomputed from the raw file? (expected: ~1)
mean_inc <- function(x) vapply(strsplit(as.character(x), ","), function(v)
  mean(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))

read_raw_rmats <- function(cell, cmp, ev) {
  f <- file.path(RMATS_BASE_DIR, cell, cmp, "output", paste0(ev, ".MATS.JC.txt"))
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  df <- read.delim(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  names(df) <- make.unique(names(df))
  cc  <- grep("Start_0base$|End$|ES$|EE$", names(df), value = TRUE)
  pos <- apply(df[, cc, drop = FALSE], 1, paste, collapse = "-")
  out <- data.frame(Event_ID = paste(ev, df$chr, df$strand, pos, sep = "_"),
                    chr = as.character(df$chr),
                    raw_diff = as.numeric(df$IncLevelDifference),
                    m1 = mean_inc(df$IncLevel1), m2 = mean_inc(df$IncLevel2),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (ev == "SE") { out$uEE <- df$upstreamEE; out$dES <- df$downstreamES }
  out
}

rm_check <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(cells), function(cell) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(COMPARISONS, function(cmp) {
    raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(EVENT_TYPES, function(ev) read_raw_rmats(cell, cmp, ev)))
    j <- dplyr::inner_join(cells[[cell]]$rm[[cmp]][, c("Event_ID", "dPSI")], raw, by = "Event_ID") %>%
      dplyr::filter(is.finite(m1), is.finite(m2))
    data.frame(cell = cell, cmp = cmp, n = nrow(j),
               loaded_vs_minus_rawdiff = cor(j$dPSI, -j$raw_diff),
               loaded_vs_m2_minus_m1   = cor(j$dPSI, j$m2 - j$m1),
               rawdiff_vs_m1_minus_m2  = cor(j$raw_diff, j$m1 - j$m2))
  }))
}))
cat("\n== 1. rMATS internal check (expected: ~1) ==\n")
print(rm_check, digits = 3)

# 2. LeafCutter: deltapsi = psi_X - psi_Control (if the psi_* columns exist)
cat("\n== 2. LeafCutter internal check (expected: ~1) ==\n")
for (cell in names(cells)) {
  d <- cells[[cell]]$lf
  for (g in c("TIS", "REPOP")) {
    cols <- c(paste0("psi_", g), "psi_Control", paste0("deltapsi_", g))
    if (all(cols %in% names(d))) {
      ok <- stats::complete.cases(d[, cols])
      cat(cell, g, ": cor(deltapsi, psi_", g, " - psi_Control) = ",
          round(cor(d[[cols[3]]][ok], (d[[cols[1]]] - d[[cols[2]]])[ok]), 3), "\n", sep = "")
    } else cat(cell, g, ": psi_* columns missing, skipped\n")
  }
}

# 3. Additivity: dPSI(CTR->TIS) + dPSI(TIS->REPOP) ~ dPSI(CTR->REPOP)
cat("\n== 3. Additivity cor(A+B, C) (expected: strongly positive) ==\n")
for (cell in names(cells)) {
  rm <- cells[[cell]]$rm
  j <- dplyr::inner_join(
    dplyr::inner_join(rm$CTR_vs_TIS[, c("Event_ID", "dPSI")], rm$TIS_vs_REPOP[, c("Event_ID", "dPSI")], by = "Event_ID"),
    rm$CTR_vs_REPOP[, c("Event_ID", "dPSI")], by = "Event_ID")
  cat(cell, "rMATS:", round(cor(j$dPSI.x + j$dPSI.y, j$dPSI), 3), sprintf("(n=%d)\n", nrow(j)))
  d <- cells[[cell]]$lf
  cat(cell, "Leaf: ", round(cor(d$deltapsi_TIS + d$deltapsi_TIS_vs_REPOP, d$deltapsi_REPOP, use = "complete.obs"), 3), "\n")
}

leaf_col <- c(CTR_vs_TIS = "deltapsi_TIS", TIS_vs_REPOP = "deltapsi_TIS_vs_REPOP", CTR_vs_REPOP = "deltapsi_REPOP")
```

# 4. Consensus genes: rMATS ∩ LeafCutter

Per comparison, the intersection of the significant genes of the two tools; the consensus set is the union of these.

```{r consensus}
consensus_by_cmp <- function(rm, lf) {
  setNames(lapply(COMPARISONS, function(cmp) intersect(rm[[cmp]], lf[[cmp]])), COMPARISONS)
}

cons_mcf7 <- consensus_by_cmp(sig_genes_mcf7_rmats, sig_genes_mcf7_leafcutter)
cons_t47d <- consensus_by_cmp(sig_genes_t47d_rmats, sig_genes_t47d_leafcutter)

consensus_genes <- function(x) sort(unique(unlist(x)))
core_mcf7 <- consensus_genes(cons_mcf7)
core_t47d <- consensus_genes(cons_t47d)
core_pan  <- intersect(core_mcf7, core_t47d)

cat("Consensus genes per comparison (MCF7):\n"); print(sapply(cons_mcf7, length))
cat("Consensus genes per comparison (T47D):\n"); print(sapply(cons_t47d, length))
cat("MCF7 consensus (union):", length(core_mcf7), "\n")
cat("T47D consensus (union):", length(core_t47d), "\n")
cat("In both cell lines:    ", length(core_pan),  "\n")
```

# 5. Trajectory logic (per consensus gene)

A = CTR→TIS, B = TIS→REPOP, C = CTR→REPOP. Significant: FDR < `SIG_THRESHOLD` and |dPSI| > `DPSI_THRESHOLD`.

```{r traj_functions}
TRAJ_LEVELS <- c("Transient", "Persistent", "Progressive", "Reversed",
                 "REPOP_specific", "Other", "Not_testable")

classify_trajectory <- function(dA, dB, dC, sA, sB, sC) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(dA) | is.na(dB) | is.na(dC)                          ~ "Not_testable",
    sA & sB & sC & sign(dB) == sign(dA) & sign(dC) == sign(dA) ~ "Progressive",
    sA & !sC & sign(dB) == -sign(dA)                           ~ "Transient",
    sA & sC & sign(dC) == sign(dA)                             ~ "Persistent",
    sA & sC & sign(dC) != sign(dA)                             ~ "Reversed",
    !sA & sC                                                   ~ "REPOP_specific",
    TRUE                                                       ~ "Other"
  )
}

is_sig <- function(fdr, dpsi) {
  !is.na(fdr) & !is.na(dpsi) & fdr < SIG_THRESHOLD & abs(dpsi) > DPSI_THRESHOLD
}

# rMATS: event level
rmats_event_traj <- function(rm_list, genes) {
  pick <- function(cmp, sfx) {
    rm_list[[cmp]] %>%
      dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% genes) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Event_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::select(Event_ID, EventType, Gene_Name, dPSI, p_val_adj) %>%
      dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_", sfx), c(dPSI, p_val_adj))
  }
  keys <- c("Event_ID", "EventType", "Gene_Name")
  pick("CTR_vs_TIS", "A") %>%
    dplyr::full_join(pick("TIS_vs_REPOP", "B"), by = keys) %>%
    dplyr::full_join(pick("CTR_vs_REPOP", "C"), by = keys) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sA = is_sig(p_val_adj_A, dPSI_A),
      sB = is_sig(p_val_adj_B, dPSI_B),
      sC = is_sig(p_val_adj_C, dPSI_C),
      Class = classify_trajectory(dPSI_A, dPSI_B, dPSI_C, sA, sB, sC)
    )
}

# LeafCutter: intron level (p.adjust is cluster-level, shared by all three comparisons)
leaf_intron_traj <- function(leaf_df, genes) {
  leaf_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name), !is.na(p.adjust)) %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(gene_name, sep = ",") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene_name = stringr::str_trim(gene_name)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_name %in% genes) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Gene_Name = gene_name, intron, cluster, FDR = p.adjust,
      dPSI_A = deltapsi_TIS, dPSI_B = deltapsi_TIS_vs_REPOP, dPSI_C = deltapsi_REPOP
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sA = is_sig(FDR, dPSI_A), sB = is_sig(FDR, dPSI_B), sC = is_sig(FDR, dPSI_C),
      Class = classify_trajectory(dPSI_A, dPSI_B, dPSI_C, sA, sB, sC)
    )
}

# Gene level: strongest rMATS event and strongest LeafCutter intron per gene
gene_trajectory <- function(cell_line, rm_list, leaf_df, genes) {
  r_ev <- rmats_event_traj(rm_list, genes)
  l_ev <- leaf_intron_traj(leaf_df, genes)

  r_top <- r_ev %>%
    dplyr::filter(Class != "Not_testable") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(minFDR = pmin(p_val_adj_A, p_val_adj_B, p_val_adj_C, na.rm = TRUE),
                  maxD   = pmax(abs(dPSI_A), abs(dPSI_B), abs(dPSI_C), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(minFDR, dplyr::desc(maxD)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Gene_Name) %>% dplyr::slice(1) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Name, rMATS_Event = EventType, rMATS_Class = Class,
                  rMATS_dPSI_A = dPSI_A, rMATS_dPSI_B = dPSI_B, rMATS_dPSI_C = dPSI_C)

  l_top <- l_ev %>%
    dplyr::filter(Class != "Not_testable") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(maxD = pmax(abs(dPSI_A), abs(dPSI_B), abs(dPSI_C), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(FDR, dplyr::desc(maxD)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Gene_Name) %>% dplyr::slice(1) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Name, Leaf_Cluster = cluster, Leaf_Class = Class,
                  Leaf_dPSI_A = dPSI_A, Leaf_dPSI_B = dPSI_B, Leaf_dPSI_C = dPSI_C)

  data.frame(Gene_Name = genes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(r_top, by = "Gene_Name") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(l_top, by = "Gene_Name") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Cell_Line   = cell_line,
      rMATS_Class = factor(dplyr::coalesce(rMATS_Class, "Not_testable"), levels = TRAJ_LEVELS),
      Leaf_Class  = factor(dplyr::coalesce(Leaf_Class,  "Not_testable"), levels = TRAJ_LEVELS),
      Class_Match = ifelse(rMATS_Class == Leaf_Class, "Match", "Mismatch")
    )
}
```

```{r traj_run}
traj_mcf7 <- gene_trajectory("MCF7", rmats_mcf7, leaf_mcf7, core_mcf7)
traj_t47d <- gene_trajectory("T47D", rmats_t47d, leaf_t47d, core_t47d)
traj_all  <- dplyr::bind_rows(traj_mcf7, traj_t47d)
```

# 6. Over-representation analysis (ORA)

Input: consensus genes only. The statistical background (universe) is the set of genes testable
in both tools in the given cell line.

```{r ora}
hallmark_t2g <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

tested_universe <- function(rm_list, leaf_df) {
  rm_g <- unique(stats::na.omit(unlist(lapply(rm_list, function(d) d$Gene_Name))))
  lf_g <- leaf_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name), !is.na(p.adjust)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene_name) %>%
    strsplit(",") %>% unlist() %>% stringr::str_trim() %>% unique()
  intersect(rm_g, lf_g)
}

run_ora <- function(genes, universe, label, hallmark_set = hallmark_t2g) {
  genes <- intersect(genes, universe)
  cat(sprintf("\n[%s] ORA input: %d genes, universe: %d genes\n", label, length(genes), length(universe)))
  out <- list()

  # --- GO:BP ---
  go <- tryCatch(
    clusterProfiler::enrichGO(gene = genes, universe = universe, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                              keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                              pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                              minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(go) && nrow(as.data.frame(go)) > 1) {
    go <- tryCatch(clusterProfiler::simplify(go, cutoff = 0.7, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min),
                   error = function(e) go)
  }
  out$GO <- go

  # --- Reactome ---
  map_ids <- function(x) {
    res <- tryCatch(
      clusterProfiler::bitr(x, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db),
      error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(res)) character(0) else res$ENTREZID
  }
  entrez_genes <- map_ids(genes)
  entrez_univ  <- map_ids(universe)

  out$Reactome <- tryCatch(
    ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene = entrez_genes, universe = entrez_univ,
                              organism = "human", pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                              pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                              minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500, readable = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL)

  # --- MSigDB Hallmark (TERM2GENE-based over-representation test with symbols) ---
  out$Hallmark <- tryCatch(
    clusterProfiler::enricher(gene = genes, universe = universe,
                              TERM2GENE = hallmark_set,
                              pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                              pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                              minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500),
    error = function(e) NULL)

  # --- Save and plot ---
  for (nm in names(out)) {
    res <- if (is.null(out[[nm]])) data.frame() else as.data.frame(out[[nm]])
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %d significant terms\n", nm, nrow(res)))
    if (nrow(res) > 0) {
      write.csv(res, sprintf("ORA_%s_%s.csv", label, nm), row.names = FALSE)
      p <- enrichplot::dotplot(out[[nm]], showCategory = 15) +
        ggplot2::ggtitle(sprintf("%s - %s ORA", label, nm))
      print(p)
    }
  }
  invisible(out)
}

univ_mcf7 <- tested_universe(rmats_mcf7, leaf_mcf7)
univ_t47d <- tested_universe(rmats_t47d, leaf_t47d)
univ_pan  <- intersect(univ_mcf7, univ_t47d)

ora_mcf7 <- run_ora(core_mcf7, univ_mcf7, "MCF7")
ora_t47d <- run_ora(core_t47d, univ_t47d, "T47D")
ora_pan  <- run_ora(core_pan,  univ_pan,  "MCF7_T47D_shared")
```

# 7. Figure 8: trajectory heatmaps (CTR→TIS and TIS→REPOP)

```{r fig8-heatmap}
save_plot <- function(filename, width, height, plot_fn, res = 300) {
  png(filename, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = res)
  plot_fn()
  dev.off()
}

LIM <- 0.4
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-LIM, 0, LIM), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))
ev_cols <- c(SE = "#4E79A7", RI = "#F28E2B", MXE = "#59A14F", A5SS = "#B07AA1", A3SS = "#E15759")
class_levels <- c("Persistent", "Progressive", "Partial", "Transient", "Reversed", "REPOP_specific")

retention_class <- function(a, c, thr = DPSI_THRESHOLD) {
  r <- c / a
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(a) | is.na(c)            ~ NA_character_,
    abs(a) < thr & abs(c) >= thr   ~ "REPOP_specific",
    abs(a) < thr                   ~ NA_character_,
    r < -0.33                      ~ "Reversed",
    r <  0.33                      ~ "Transient",
    r <  0.67                      ~ "Partial",
    r <= 1.33                      ~ "Persistent",
    TRUE                           ~ "Progressive"
  )
}

prep_traj <- function(traj) {
  traj %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(rMATS_dPSI_A), !is.na(rMATS_dPSI_C)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(a = rMATS_dPSI_A, c = rMATS_dPSI_C,
                  cls = factor(retention_class(a, c), levels = class_levels),
                  lead = ifelse(cls == "REPOP_specific", c, a)) %>%      # block direction
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(cls)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cls, dplyr::desc(lead))                               # within block: + top, - bottom
}

# Top 2 most pronounced genes per block
top_idx <- function(d, k = 2) {
  d %>% dplyr::mutate(i = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cls) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(abs(a) + abs(c), n = k, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::pull(i)
}

common_args_trans <- list(
  name = "dPSI", col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_gap = grid::unit(2.5, "mm"),
  row_title_rot = 0, row_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  column_names_rot = 0, column_names_centered = TRUE, column_names_side = "top",
  column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 14),
  border = TRUE, rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = NA), use_raster = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "dPSI\n(Transition)", at = c(-LIM, -LIM / 2, 0, LIM / 2, LIM))
)

traj_heatmap_transitions <- function(traj, cell_label) {
  d <- prep_traj(traj)
  # Column 1: CTR->TIS (= TIS vs CTR dPSI); column 2: TIS->REPOP (= REPOP-vs-CTR minus TIS-vs-CTR)
  mat <- cbind("CTR->TIS" = d$a, "TIS->REPOP" = d$c - d$a)
  rownames(mat) <- d$Gene_Name

  idx <- top_idx(d)
  do.call(ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap, c(list(
    mat, row_split = d$cls, column_title = cell_label, width = grid::unit(6, "cm"),
    right_annotation = ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
      Event = d$rMATS_Event, col = list(Event = ev_cols),
      Gene = ComplexHeatmap::anno_mark(at = idx, labels = d$Gene_Name[idx],
                                       labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9)),
      annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9))
  ), common_args_trans))
}

ht_mcf7_trans <- traj_heatmap_transitions(traj_mcf7, "MCF7")
ht_t47d_trans <- traj_heatmap_transitions(traj_t47d, "T47D")

# Both heatmaps side by side with one shared legend
draw_combined <- function() {
  pd <- ComplexHeatmap::packLegend(
    ComplexHeatmap::Legend(title = "dPSI\n(Transition)", col_fun = col_fun,
                           at = c(-LIM, -LIM / 2, 0, LIM / 2, LIM)),
    ComplexHeatmap::Legend(title = "Event", at = names(ev_cols),
                           legend_gp = grid::gpar(fill = ev_cols)),
    direction = "vertical"
  )

  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout = grid::grid.layout(nrow = 1, ncol = 2)))

  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_mcf7_trans, show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
                       show_annotation_legend = FALSE, newpage = FALSE)
  grid::popViewport()

  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 2))
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_t47d_trans, show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
                       show_annotation_legend = FALSE, newpage = FALSE)
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(pd, x = grid::unit(0.95, "npc"), y = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
                       just = c("right", "center"))
  grid::popViewport()
}

save_plot("heatmap_transitions_Combined.png", width = 10.5, height = 10, plot_fn = draw_combined)
```

# 8. Figure 9: UpSet plots (rMATS vs LeafCutter, three comparisons)

```{r fig9-upset}
cmp_short <- c(CTR_vs_TIS = "CTR vs TIS", TIS_vs_REPOP = "TIS vs REPOP", CTR_vs_REPOP = "CTR vs REPOP")
col_tool  <- c(rMATS = "#4E79A7", LeafCutter = "#F28E2B", Both = "#C0392B")

upset_integrated <- function(rm, lf, title, top_n = 20) {
  sets <- c(setNames(rm[COMPARISONS], paste("rMATS", cmp_short[COMPARISONS])),
            setNames(lf[COMPARISONS], paste("LC",    cmp_short[COMPARISONS])))
  is_rm <- grepl("^rMATS", names(sets))

  m <- ComplexHeatmap::make_comb_mat(sets, mode = "distinct")
  m <- m[ComplexHeatmap::comb_size(m) > 0]
  m <- m[order(ComplexHeatmap::comb_size(m), decreasing = TRUE)]
  m <- m[seq_len(min(top_n, ncol(m)))]

  bits <- sapply(ComplexHeatmap::comb_name(m), function(s) as.integer(strsplit(s, "")[[1]]))
  bits <- matrix(bits, nrow = length(sets))
  has_rm <- colSums(bits[is_rm,  , drop = FALSE]) > 0
  has_lf <- colSums(bits[!is_rm, , drop = FALSE]) > 0
  tool <- ifelse(has_rm & has_lf, "Both", ifelse(has_rm, "rMATS", "LeafCutter"))
  cc <- unname(col_tool[tool])

  ComplexHeatmap::UpSet(
    m, comb_order = seq_len(ncol(m)), set_order = names(sets),
    width  = unit(top_n * 3.5, "mm"),
    height = unit(35, "mm"),
    pt_size = unit(2.4, "mm"), lwd = 1.5, comb_col = cc,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    top_annotation = ComplexHeatmap::upset_top_annotation(
      m, add_numbers = TRUE, numbers_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
      gp = gpar(fill = cc, col = NA), height = unit(30, "mm"),
      annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontfamily = "Arial"),
      axis_param = list(side = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontfamily = "Arial"))),
    right_annotation = ComplexHeatmap::upset_right_annotation(
      m, add_numbers = TRUE, numbers_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
      width = unit(18, "mm"),
      gp = gpar(fill = ifelse(is_rm, col_tool[["rMATS"]], col_tool[["LeafCutter"]]), col = NA),
      annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontfamily = "Arial"),
      axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontfamily = "Arial"))),
    column_title = title,
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 13, fontfamily = "Arial")
  )
}

lgd <- ComplexHeatmap::Legend(title = "Tool", at = names(col_tool), legend_gp = gpar(fill = col_tool),
              labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontfamily = "Arial"),
              title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Arial"))

draw_vertical <- function() {
  grid.newpage()
  pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(
    nrow = 2, ncol = 3,
    widths = unit(c(1, 5, 20), c("null", "mm", "mm"))
  )))

  # Panel A: MCF7
  pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(upset_integrated(sig_genes_mcf7_rmats, sig_genes_mcf7_leafcutter, "MCF7"), newpage = FALSE)
  grid.text("A", x = unit(2, "mm"), y = unit(1, "npc") - unit(2, "mm"),
            just = c("left", "top"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Arial"))
  popViewport()

  # Panel B: T47D
  pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 1))
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(upset_integrated(sig_genes_t47d_rmats, sig_genes_t47d_leafcutter, "T47D"), newpage = FALSE)
  grid.text("B", x = unit(2, "mm"), y = unit(1, "npc") - unit(2, "mm"),
            just = c("left", "top"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Arial"))
  popViewport()

  # Legend in the third column
  pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 3))
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(lgd, x = unit(0, "mm"), y = unit(0.7, "npc"), just = c("left", "top"))
  popViewport()

  popViewport()
}

png("upset_integrated_vertical.png", width = 160, height = 210, units = "mm", res = 300, bg = "white")
```

# 9. Cross-cell-line overlap (corrected Jaccard index)

```{r jaccard-rmats}
# Events tested in both cell lines (shared testable universe)
mcf7_tested_events <- unique(unlist(lapply(rmats_mcf7, function(df) df$Event_ID)))
t47d_tested_events <- unique(unlist(lapply(rmats_t47d, function(df) df$Event_ID)))
shared_testable_events <- intersect(mcf7_tested_events, t47d_tested_events)

get_sig_events <- function(rm_list) {
  unique(unlist(lapply(rm_list, function(df) {
    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD) %>%
      dplyr::pull(Event_ID)
  })))
}

mcf7_sig_filtered <- intersect(get_sig_events(rmats_mcf7), shared_testable_events)
t47d_sig_filtered <- intersect(get_sig_events(rmats_t47d), shared_testable_events)

overlap_count     <- length(intersect(mcf7_sig_filtered, t47d_sig_filtered))
union_count       <- length(union(mcf7_sig_filtered, t47d_sig_filtered))
corrected_jaccard <- overlap_count / union_count * 100

cat("--- rMATS cross-cell-line overlap (shared universe) ---\n")
cat("Shared testable events:", length(shared_testable_events), "\n")
cat("MCF7 significant (restricted):", length(mcf7_sig_filtered), "\n")
cat("T47D significant (restricted):", length(t47d_sig_filtered), "\n")
cat("Overlap:", overlap_count, "\n")
cat("Corrected Jaccard index:", round(corrected_jaccard, 2), "%\n")
```

```{r jaccard-leafcutter}
get_leaf_tested_genes <- function(leaf_df) {
  leaf_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p.adjust), !is.na(gene_name)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene_name) %>%
    strsplit(",") %>% unlist() %>% stringr::str_trim() %>% unique()
}

shared_leaf_universe <- intersect(get_leaf_tested_genes(leaf_mcf7), get_leaf_tested_genes(leaf_t47d))

mcf7_leaf_filtered <- intersect(unique(unlist(sig_genes_mcf7_leafcutter)), shared_leaf_universe)
t47d_leaf_filtered <- intersect(unique(unlist(sig_genes_t47d_leafcutter)), shared_leaf_universe)

leaf_overlap <- length(intersect(mcf7_leaf_filtered, t47d_leaf_filtered))
leaf_union   <- length(union(mcf7_leaf_filtered, t47d_leaf_filtered))
leaf_jaccard <- leaf_overlap / leaf_union * 100

cat("--- LeafCutter cross-cell-line overlap (shared universe) ---\n")
cat("Shared testable genes:", length(shared_leaf_universe), "\n")
cat("MCF7 significant (restricted):", length(mcf7_leaf_filtered), "\n")
cat("T47D significant (restricted):", length(t47d_leaf_filtered), "\n")
cat("Overlap:", leaf_overlap, "\n")
cat("Corrected LeafCutter Jaccard index:", round(leaf_jaccard, 2), "%\n")
```

# 10. Figure 10: rMATS vs LeafCutter directional concordance (unfiltered LeafCutter)

SE events significant in rMATS (ground truth) are matched by exact junction coordinates to
LeafCutter introns, with no significance or effect-size filter on the LeafCutter side.
The LeafCutter dPSI of the skipping intron is multiplied by −1 to make it comparable to inclusion.

```{r fig10-concordance}
TOL <- 2  # bp tolerance for 0/1-based coordinates

se_map_unfiltered <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(cells), function(cell) {

  # LeafCutter: NO filtering (no p.adjust or dPSI cutoff)
  lf_unfiltered <- cells[[cell]]$lf %>%
    dplyr::mutate(chr = sub(":.*", "", intron),
                  s = as.numeric(sub("^[^:]+:([0-9]+):.*", "\\1", intron)),
                  e = as.numeric(sub("^[^:]+:[0-9]+:([0-9]+):.*", "\\1", intron)))

  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(COMPARISONS, function(cmp) {
    raw <- read_raw_rmats(cell, cmp, "SE")

    # rMATS: ground-truth set (significance filter kept here)
    se <- dplyr::inner_join(cells[[cell]]$rm[[cmp]][, c("Event_ID", "EventType", "dPSI", "p_val_adj")],
                            raw[, c("Event_ID", "chr", "uEE", "dES")], by = "Event_ID") %>%
      dplyr::filter(EventType == "SE", p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD)

    col <- leaf_col[[cmp]]

    suppressWarnings(dplyr::inner_join(se, lf_unfiltered[, c("chr", "s", "e", col)], by = "chr")) %>%
      dplyr::filter(abs(s - (uEE + 1)) <= TOL, abs(e - dES) <= TOL) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[col]])) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(cell = cell, cmp = cmp, rMATS_dPSI = dPSI, Leaf_dPSI_incl = -.data[[col]])
  }))
}))

# Event-level aggregation (several introns can match one event)
se_merged_unfiltered <- se_map_unfiltered %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell, cmp, Event_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    rMATS_dPSI = dplyr::first(rMATS_dPSI),
    Leaf_dPSI_incl = mean(Leaf_dPSI_incl, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Concordant = ifelse(sign(rMATS_dPSI) == sign(Leaf_dPSI_incl), "Same direction", "Opposite direction"),
    Concordant = factor(Concordant, levels = c("Same direction", "Opposite direction"))
  )

conc_stats_unfiltered_total <- se_merged_unfiltered %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n         = dplyr::n(),
    n_conc    = sum(Concordant == "Same direction"),
    pct_conc  = floor(100 * n_conc / n),   # floor: conservative label (no rounding up)
    r_pearson = if (n >= 3) cor(rMATS_dPSI, Leaf_dPSI_incl, method = "pearson")  else NA_real_,
    r_spear   = if (n >= 3) cor(rMATS_dPSI, Leaf_dPSI_incl, method = "spearman") else NA_real_,
    p_binom   = if (n >= 1) binom.test(n_conc, n, p = 0.5)$p.value else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = sprintf("n = %d\nPearson r = %.2f\nSpearman \u03c1 = %.2f\nConcordant: %.0f%% (p %s)",
                                n, r_pearson, r_spear, pct_conc,
                                ifelse(p_binom < 0.05, "< 0.05", sprintf("= %.3f", p_binom))))

print(conc_stats_unfiltered_total %>% dplyr::select(-label))

col_conc <- c("Same direction" = "#238B45", "Opposite direction" = "#C0392B")
lim <- ceiling(max(abs(c(se_merged_unfiltered$rMATS_dPSI, se_merged_unfiltered$Leaf_dPSI_incl)), na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10

p_conc_unfiltered_total <- ggplot(se_merged_unfiltered, aes(rMATS_dPSI, Leaf_dPSI_incl, colour = Concordant)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -DPSI_THRESHOLD, ymax = DPSI_THRESHOLD, fill = "grey95") +
  annotate("rect", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, xmin = -DPSI_THRESHOLD, xmax = DPSI_THRESHOLD, fill = "grey95") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.4) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6, formula = y ~ x) +
  geom_text(data = conc_stats_unfiltered_total, aes(x = -lim * 0.95, y = lim * 0.95, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, lineheight = 0.95) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_conc, name = NULL) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
  labs(x = "rMATS dPSI (Filtered Ground Truth)",
       y = "LeafCutter dPSI (Unfiltered match)",
       title = "Effect-direction concordance: rMATS vs LeafCutter (Unfiltered)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_conc_unfiltered_total)
ggsave("effect_concordance_unfiltered_merged.png", p_conc_unfiltered_total,
       width = 7.5, height = 7.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# 11. Figure 17: trajectory profiles of shared events (mean |dPSI|)

Requires `ht_pan` and `mat2` (heatmap of the genes shared by both cell lines). These come from a chunk that is **not** in this file.

```{r fig17-profiles}
ht_drawn   <- ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_pan, merge_legend = TRUE)
row_orders <- ComplexHeatmap::row_order(ht_drawn)

cluster_assignments <- data.frame(
  Gene_Type = rownames(mat2)[unlist(row_orders)],
  Cluster   = rep(names(row_orders), times = sapply(row_orders, length)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

df_mat <- as.data.frame(mat2)
colnames(df_mat) <- c("CTR_vs_TIS_MCF7", "CTR_vs_REPOP_MCF7", "CTR_vs_TIS_T47D", "CTR_vs_REPOP_T47D")
df_mat$Gene_Type <- rownames(mat2)

df_long <- df_mat %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cluster_assignments, by = "Gene_Type") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Gene_Type, Cluster),
    names_to = c("Condition", "CellLine"),
    names_pattern = "(CTR_vs_TIS|CTR_vs_REPOP)_(MCF7|T47D)",
    values_to = "dPSI"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("CTR_vs_TIS", "CTR_vs_REPOP"),
                       labels = c("CTR\u2192TIS", "CTR\u2192REPOP")),
    CellLine = factor(CellLine, levels = c("MCF7", "T47D"))
  )

# Mean and standard error of ABSOLUTE dPSI per cluster and condition
df_summary <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cluster, Condition, CellLine) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_abs_dPSI = mean(abs(dPSI), na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(abs(dPSI), na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# CTR baseline so that every line starts at 0
df_baseline <- df_summary %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Cluster, CellLine) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Condition = "CTR", mean_abs_dPSI = 0, se = 0)

df_summary_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_baseline, df_summary) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("CTR", "CTR\u2192TIS", "CTR\u2192REPOP")))

p_profiles <- ggplot(df_summary_full, aes(x = Condition, y = mean_abs_dPSI, group = CellLine, color = CellLine)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_abs_dPSI - se, ymax = mean_abs_dPSI + se), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cluster, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("MCF7" = "#2166AC", "T47D" = "#B2182B")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "Shared splicing events between cell lines",
    subtitle = "Trajectory profiles (Mean Absolute |\u0394PSI| avoids cancellation)",
    x = "Condition",
    y = expression(paste("Mean Absolute |", Delta, "PSI| vs CTR"))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_profiles)
ggsave("cross_cell_line_cluster_profiles_absolute.png", p_profiles, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
